note: Provider answers to the calls the DMM Cast play routes make. Each entry says where it comes from. No credential, member link or member address appears below.

rd-permission-denied.request: A Real-Debrid torrent call made by DMM's uploader for a member (endpoint not recorded)
rd-permission-denied.source: Real-Debrid's answer to a member's key, as DMM's uploader stored it (src/test/fixtures/contentRequests/stored-errors.json). Real-Debrid documents HTTP 403 as 'Permission denied (account locked, not premium)' for every endpoint, unrestrict included. The play route's own log keeps only the status: 29 of the 39 unrestrict failures in dmm-01's logs 2026-10-03 22:21-23:38 UTC were 403, from 5 installs, 4 of which had not played anything all week.

rd-unrestrict-hoster-unavailable.source: A stored link that had aged out, measured 2026-08-29: the same answer on every retry over four minutes.

rd-unrestrict-infringing-file.source: Recorded 2026-10-04: a 13-character link stored in Cast on 2024-11-23, unrestricted once with a test account.

rd-unrestrict-ip-not-allowed.source: The body Real-Debrid sent a hosting-provider address when it refused to make a link, with that address replaced by a documentation one. zurg logged the same refusal as 'ip_not_allowed (status code: 403)'.

tb-rate-limited.source: TorBox's lockout answer, measured 2026-08-02: a bare string, and the whole key is refused for the Retry-After window. Requests made during it do not extend it.
